description:
BROE auctioneers take great pleasure in presenting 110 to the market. Fantastic extended three bedroom home with the added benefit of being fully wrapped and large rear garden c.(27 m). Mature and peaceful residential area. No 110 represents a great opportunity to purchase a substantial home in excellent condition throughout for both first time buyers and young families. Mourne Road is perfectly situated, with every amenity imaginable located on your doorstep including schools, shopping facilities in the villages of Rialto, Kilmainham, Kimmage and Crumlin which are all within walking distance. Transport links are ideal with the Suir Road LUAS stop within a short stroll as well as a number of bus routes linking to the City Centre and further afield. The location offers quick and easy access to both the city and M50.  A real feature is the private walled rear garden c. (27 m) mainly in lawn. Well maintained by its owners, a generously proportioned living room and dining room, extended kitchen and sunroom makes for comfortable family living. Upstairs three bedrooms and revamped bathroom contribute to making this an ideal family home.

Contact Craig Leap at BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
